values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/parmaleebridge ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Parmalee Bridge State Forest Campground, Oscoda: rustic, closed Dec 1 to April 15, managed by Rifle River RA 989-473-2258, 7/G sites, $20, 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/parmaleebridge ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'Convenient amenities include a centrally located hand-pump well and dumpster.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/parmaleebridge ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Parmalee Bridge: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Seven shaded drive-in sites under red pines, plus a paddle-in/walk-in group site on the west side (four fire pits, six tables). No length posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/parmaleebridge ('Campground: Seven shaded campsites, tucked beneath towering red pines.' 'Group site: A paddle-in campsite on the west side features four fire pits and six picnic tables.' 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site.') + amenity table ('7/G'), read 2026-10-25

note: Small rustic state forest campground and canoe camp on the Au Sable River, 10 miles west of Mio via M-72, Mapes, Brown Cabin, Deeter and North Red Oak roads, Oscoda County. A sunny picnic area lies between the sites and the river; gravel-and-sand boat launch, and carry-in paddling access about 100 yards from the parking area down a set of stairs. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20 (confirmed), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only (confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max (inherited, now stated); 7 sites (new) plus a paddle-in group site. Season (closed Dec 1 - Apr 15) already manual, left. Phone 989-473-2258 (Rifle River RA) matches. Not equestrian; not an ORV camp (table: ORV operation 'no'). Access via M-72 and county roads, no road warning. Waterfront left: the sites are separated from the river by a picnic area. Note trimmed of field restatements.
